verdict.rationale: Formant ships its own non-GUI programmatic surfaces: a Python Cloud SDK for querying and ingesting data without the web app, an Admin API for custom commands, and a Docker-installable device agent configurable through environment variables. Together these allow scripted, headless automation, but nothing documents a CLI, a CI integration, or a non-production environment for automated runs. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or headless mode, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, a test/sandbox environment for automated runs (the API console targets production only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The primary programmatic way data scientists query for telemetry data is via the Cloud SDK, a lightweight Python module which can interact with the query API.
sometimes you may want to ingest directly without requiring an agent. The `ingest` method of the Formant Cloud SDK is a good option
you can create custom commands via the Formant Admin API.
You can use environment variables to control Formant agent behavior.
This guide will teach you how to install the Formant agent to your device via Docker.
